title: Equal singleton Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube with sign-valued output. The singleton Fourier coefficients of the associated real-valued function are equal: for every pair of coordinates $i,j\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the coefficient indexed by $\{i\}$ equals the coefficient indexed by $\{j\}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube with sign-valued output
